sql:
-- Build FIFO allocation simulation
-- Step 1: List all order-product combinations in chronological order
WITH order_demands AS (
    SELECT o.id as order_id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, 
           SUM(ol.qty) as demand_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN orderlines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = ol.product_id
    GROUP BY o.id, o.ordered, ol.product_id, p.name
),
-- Step 2: List inventory sorted by product, purchase_date (FIFO), then qty (smallest first)
inventory_fifo AS (
    SELECT inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.qty, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty, inv.id) as rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN purchases p ON p.id = inv.purchase_id
),
-- Step 3: Get cumulative inventory available per product
inv_cumulative AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchased, qty,
           SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_inv
    FROM inventory
    JOIN purchases p ON p.id = inventory.purchase_id
)
